description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'fetch' that retrieves data from files, URLs (HTTP/FTP), and displays or assigns the content within Smarty templates. It includes logic for local file access, HTTP requests with headers and proxy support, and FTP access.

methods.name: smarty_function_fetch
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified file, URL, or FTP location, with support for security checks, headers, proxy, and authentication, then returns or assigns the content.
